messages:
Tanvi Mehra: Hi folks! Tanvi here, joining Eng-ML from IST. First day excitement + quick setup Qs. Who to ping for MDM and VPN steps? Also who handles access to the 'model-serving-prod' read-only bucket? Fun fact: I'm into birdwatching and brew a mean masala chai. Two truths & a lie: paraglided in Goa, can play tabla, terrified of pigeons. :wave:
Arman (Onboarding): Welcome Tanvi!! Onboarding checklist sent. Steps: accept Okta invite, follow the MDM link in the email, then WireGuard profile auto-provisions. If the MDM step errors, paste the error text here and we'll help. I'll add you to #eng-ml and #new-hires.
IT: Hey Tanvi  laptop assigned (asset R-9099) and will ship tomorrow. MDM tip for macOS: if you see "Profile installation failed", run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` then reboot. WireGuard: `brew install wireguard-tools`, import the .conf from email and run `wg-quick up redwood`. If `wg-quick` fails, paste `wg show` output (we'll redact IPs).
DevX Bot: account-created: GitHub invite sent, Slack channels added, calendar 1:1 with Leah scheduled.
Leah Park: For model-serving-prod access, open an infra ticket at https://intranet.redwood/infra-request with project `model-serving-prod` and request `roles/storage.objectViewer`. Tag me and Sami and I can expedite. For quick local testing, clone `git@github.com:redwood/dev-starter.git` and run `./scripts/run_local.sh --model redwood-tiny`.
Tanvi Mehra: Thanks! One more: how do I request a standing desk and a second monitor? Also curious if anyone in APAC wants to trade chai recipes.
Sami: Use equipment form: https://intranet.redwood/equipment-request -> choose "Ergo" for desk or "Monitor" for extras, set priority "new hire". For APAC folks, we've got a chai thread in #random if you want to swap recipes.
Tanvi Mehra: Posting a short intro in #general now. Fun fact reveal: tabla is true, paragliding is true, terrified of pigeons is the lie (I actually chase them away during birdwatching). :tea: :bird:
